people.name: Ephesus

people.name: Miletus
people.line: A city in Asia Minor visited by Paul

translations.web: From Miletus he sent to Ephesus, and called to himself the elders of the assembly.
translations.bsb: From Miletus, Paul sent to Ephesus for the elders of the church.
translations.kjv: And from Miletus he sent to Ephesus, and called the elders of the church.
